description: Exports a Fabric Ontology item to standard OWL RDF/XML format. Compatible with Ontology Playground, Protege, and standard RDF tools. Use --format jsonld for JSON-LD output.
notes: Without --file, outputs raw RDF/XML to stdout. The exported file can be re-imported with `fabio ontology import --file ontology.rdf`. Round-trip (Fabric → RDF → Fabric) preserves entity types, datatype properties, relationships, and the fabio-native property annotations: identifier parts (→ ont:isIdentifier), time-series properties (→ ont:isTimeSeries), untyped properties (valueType Any → ont:isUntyped), and property types (→ ont:propertyType). NOT exported to OWL: entity inheritance (baseEntityTypeId), entity Documents/Overviews/ResourceLinks, and data bindings/contextualizations (OWL has no equivalent). Re-apply bindings on import with --lakehouse/--eventhouse (+ --bindings) or `ontology bind`; re-supply inheritance via the binding map's baseEntityType or by keeping rdfs:subClassOf in the source RDF.
